scripts.build: npm run build:kakomonn-reader && npm run build:kakomonn-sync
scripts.open:kakomonn: npm run open:kakomonn:browser && npm run open:kakomonn:url
scripts.test: npm run test:local && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:kakomonn-live-site && npm run test:kakomonn-live-open && npm run test:kakomonn-live-sync
scripts.test:local: npm run test:dependencies && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:repository-naming && npm run test:static-cache-policy && npm run test:kakomonn-config && npm run test:kakomonn-sync-launcher && npm run test:open-kakomonn && npm run test:appium-cli && npm run test:release-script && npm run test:live-sync-script && npm run test:kakomonn-reader && npm run test:kakomonn-sync
scripts.test:kakomonn-reader: npm run build:kakomonn-reader && envx-node run --test kakomonn-reader/tests/study_time_controller_test.mjs kakomonn-reader/tests/copy_controller_test.mjs kakomonn-reader/tests/build_test.mjs kakomonn-reader/tests/feedback_kpi_test.mjs kakomonn-reader/tests/runtime_recycle_test.mjs kakomonn-reader/tests/swipe_navigation_test.mjs kakomonn-reader/tests/userscript_metadata_test.mjs && envx-node acorn --ecma2020 --silent kakomonn-reader/dist/kakomonn-reader.user.js
scripts.test:kakomonn-dashboard: npm run build:kakomonn-sync && envx-node run kakomonn-sync/tests/dashboard_e2e_test.js
scripts.test:smoke: npm run build:kakomonn-sync && envx-node run kakomonn-reader/tests/smoke_test.js && envx-node run kakomonn-reader/tests/time_limit_smoke_test.js && envx-node run kakomonn-reader/tests/webkit_smoke_test.js && envx-node run kakomonn-sync/tests/dashboard_e2e_test.js
scripts.deploy:kakomonn-sync: npm run test:kakomonn-sync && npm run test:kakomonn-dashboard && envx-node wrangler deploy --config kakomonn-sync/wrangler.jsonc && npm run test:kakomonn-sync-production && npm run test:kakomonn-live-dashboard && npm run test:kakomonn-copy-failure-production
